selection_rules: Locate a rank-1 semiconductor row with a header for the target current month; parse the rightmost current-month amount/growth pair inside the table header x boundary. Legacy row unit is USD million; preserve exact integer and convert to 100m USD only for comparison.

Or locate semiconductor as a table column under a category header, followed by export amount and growth rows; require each nearest numeric token center within 15 PDF points of the header center and source caption unit 100m USD.

Require source month/header agreement, finite amount and signed growth, and no other contradictory qualifying table pair within the same PDF. Duplicated equivalent table blocks are one source assertion.
For the three dual-version months, require every version to yield the same source pair; do not choose a favorable version.
Keep the 2020-05 p6 80.1 narrative versus p10 table 80.7 discrepancy as an explicit within-document conflict even if the table row is selected for current-document semantics.
No English or latest-statistics replacement for missing original Korean table values; report unresolved with page/box evidence.

outputs: source-only per-version candidate table pairs with page/box, unit, conflict and dual-version audit; factor series remains unqualified until complete and timing gates checked
stop_conditions: Any source PDF or index hash mismatch stops before parsing.
If rule fails a positive sample control or a dual version, preserve failure and stop this selector; no coordinate tolerance or sign adjustment using SOXX outcomes.
If any month lacks a unique qualified pair, do not construct a 93-month factor vector.
